A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ORT research. Their text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E support reliable comparison; the different pagination does not indicate missing essential material.

before.justification: v2 reports original WebQSP and CWQ evaluations, comparisons across three LLMs, and component ablations in Tables 1–4 and 6.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark evaluations, LLM comparisons and ablation results, including the detailed appendix results.

M1.justification: Aim/condition recognition, ontology-based reverse-tree construction, condition/cycle/semantic pruning, and guided answer mining are unchanged. Algorithm 1 and the appendix prompt templates are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same English KGQA coverage using WebQSP and CWQ with Freebase. No dataset, task, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 and 6 retain the same comparator membership, including the SR variants, KD-CoT, RoG, direct LLMs, MindMap and KG Retriever. The comparisons under each LLM backbone are unchanged.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the same test sets of 1,628 WebQSP and 3,531 CWQ questions, LLM configurations and evaluation metrics. Appendix B continues to specify MAX_POP = 5 and TOP_K = 10.

E4.justification: Section 3.5 and Table 4 retain the w/o LLM Filter, Trace Forward and w/o Rules ablations. Appendix E retains the same Lou Seal and Ovadia Yosef cases in Tables 7–8; no supplementary analysis is added.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical significance tests. Uncertainty reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted values and qualitative findings are unchanged, including relocated appendix results. For example, Table 2 retains DeepSeek-v3 + ORT Hit@1/F1 of 89.43/71.83 on WebQSP and 72.91/62.63 on CWQ.

T1.justification: The ontology definitions, neighbor dictionary equations and metric formulas in Equations (1)–(6) are retained. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem or proof is introduced or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about ontology-guided reverse thinking, plug-and-play LLM enhancement and state-of-the-art performance. The stated scientific contributions have unchanged scope.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and ablation explanations are unchanged. Both versions retain the limitations concerning numerous label-compatible entities and irrelevant entity paths entering final answer generation.

D1.justification: v3 adds a public-code availability statement and GitHub repository link in the abstract, absent from v2. Existing implementation details, hyperparameters and prompts are unchanged; the supplied PDFs do not establish the repository's contents or functionality.

R1.justification: v3 removes eight distinct bibliography works, including TPO, Q*, BPP-Search, Tree of Thoughts and ReST-MCTS*, without changing the related-work discussion. The removed duplicate Shen preprint represents the same work as its retained conference version.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to the added code sentence, bibliography cleanup, citation-year disambiguation and the updated arXiv header. Section order, appendix organization and the scientific narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All nine figures and eight tables retain their content and basic design. Text and appendix placements reflow, and spacing changes make some score/gain annotations in Table 2 more crowded.

improvement.justification: The new code-location statement supplies reproducibility guidance absent from v2, providing a modest benefit despite more crowded annotations in Table 2. Bibliography cleanup also removes duplication. The method, empirical support and limitations remain unchanged, and repository functionality cannot be verified from the PDFs.
